description.narrative: The project will undertake a public financial management and debt management assessment. The work will be closely coordinated with the IMF's FAD department and will feed into planned World Bank ESW for FY09 - A Public Expenditure Review. This is part of the Bank's core diagnostic work envisaged in the re-engagement strategy with the Seychelles. Fiscal imabalances in the last few years lie behind current macroeconomic and exchange rate imabalances that need to be addressed for macro stability and ultimately economic growth. Budget plans to reduce fiscal deficits have not come to fruition as spending exceeded cielings and goals established at the start of the fiscal year. This PEFA-type assessment will diagnose weaknesses in the PFM system which once addressed will enable budget execution to live up to budgetary plans. The large fiscal deficits have been financed by a mix of domestic and external financing resulting in Seychelles becoming one of the most highly indebted countries in the world (approximately 198 percent of GDP). The Government is also requesting assistance to improve debt management as part of its approach to improving PFM and fiscal outcomes for a more sustained growth path. The objective of this grant is to enhance the capacity of the Department of Public Administration in the Vice Presidency to effectively manage the implementation of the broad public sector reform program which was adopted by the Government on June 3, 2009, and has an associated Memorandum of Action for implementation adopted by the Cabinet in August 2009.
